about: California county and city grant programs, entered by hand from each program's own page. Not a complete list. Change an entry only from the official page, and update its checked date (docs/county-coverage.md).

programs.title: Organizational Grant Program
programs.agency: Los Angeles County Department of Arts and Culture
programs.objectives: Two-year grants to Los Angeles County nonprofit arts organizations whose services give residents direct access to arts activities and programming.
programs.who: Tax-exempt organizations (IRS) with principal offices in Los Angeles County, a primary arts mission and at least two full years of arts programming there, and fiscally sponsored groups with a verified California fiscal sponsor under a Model A comprehensive sponsorship agreement.
programs.application: Apply through the department's Organizational Grant Program pages. New applicants must attend or watch a workshop.
programs.award: The request limit depends on budget size. A dollar-for-dollar cash match is required; in-kind support does not count.
programs.deadlines: The 2027-28 round closed October 5, 2026. The guidelines say applications are accepted annually; no next date is published.

programs.title: Community Impact Arts Grant
programs.agency: Los Angeles County Department of Arts and Culture
programs.objectives: Arts projects at nonprofit social service and social justice organizations, city departments, tribal governments and fiscally sponsored organizations.
programs.who: Nonprofits whose main work is not arts (501(c)(3), budget of $25,000 or more, offices in the county, two years of arts-based activities), city departments, tribal governments and projects under a California fiscal sponsor. Arts-specific nonprofits, individuals and K-12 schools are not eligible.
programs.application: Apply through the department's grant pages.
programs.award: Request up to $10,000; awards are usually less than requested. A dollar-for-dollar cash match is required; in-kind support does not count.
programs.deadlines: The 2027-28 round closed October 5, 2026. The guidelines say applications are accepted annually and mention a 2028-29 cycle; no date is set.

programs.title: Care First Community Investment (CFCI) Year 5 Care Grants
programs.agency: Los Angeles County Justice, Care and Opportunities Department
programs.objectives: Community programs that provide alternatives to incarceration and direct community investment, in 30 program areas.
programs.who: 501(c)(3) nonprofits, certain Tribes, business entities such as LLCs, or fiscally sponsored groups, with at least two years of services in Los Angeles County and headquarters there.
programs.application: Applications went to a third-party administrator for each strategy area.
programs.award: More than $73 million across the program areas.
programs.deadlines: Year 5, the fifth round, closed September 8, 2026. No next date is published.

programs.title: CDBG Notice of Funding Availability (PY2027-28)
programs.agency: San Bernardino County Community Development and Housing
programs.objectives: Public services and capital improvements for low and moderate income communities in the county's CDBG participating cities.
programs.who: Eligible entities, including cities and nonprofit organizations. Cities with their own HUD funding are not part of the program.
programs.award: About $4.7 million anticipated for the Urban County program, about $2.6 million of it for participating cities.
programs.deadlines: The 2027-28 program year closed October 15, 2026, at 4 p.m. No next date is published.
programs.source_note: The notice says the participating cities "and surrounding communities" take part. Only the 14 cities it names are matched here, so check the notice if you work nearby.

programs.title: ARTSFUND Grants Program (2027)
programs.objectives: General operating support for Alameda County arts and cultural nonprofits, for July 2027 to June 2029.
programs.who: Nonprofit arts and cultural organizations serving the county; the grant terms also cover applications made through a fiscal sponsor.
programs.application: Apply online through the link on the page, by 5 p.m.
programs.deadlines: Applications opened November 23, 2026 and are due Thursday, February 4, 2027, at 5 p.m.
programs.source_note: The 2027 guidelines weren't read (their host's robots.txt can't be read), so check them for matching funds and tax status rules.

programs.title: Transient Occupancy Tax (TOT) Grant Program (FY2026-27)
programs.agency: Sacramento County Office of Budget and Debt Management
programs.objectives: Project and program grants to Sacramento County nonprofits in arts and culture, community development, economic or workforce development, and health and human services. Not general operating support.
programs.who: Nonprofits that have completed one fiscal year and have a physical presence and services in the county; fiscal sponsors are permitted.
programs.application: Apply online in the TOT Grant Portal.
programs.award: $5,000 to $35,000; $1,000,000 a year in all. Paid by reimbursement.
programs.deadlines: FY2026-27, the tenth cycle, closed February 13, 2026. No next date is published.
